items.title: Roger Kellaway interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: So it’s a duet with Paula Cole. She came in and sang beautifully... I recorded with Paula Cole on Sammy Cahn.

ctx.x: Cool. What’s in the can for you right now?
Well we finished the Gary LeMel project, that will come out probably in March, that’s the “Bobby Darin Homage,” to which we recorded Paula Cole doing — the song has escaped me.
